why: Lane B compares an Error by its class and message, never by its stack text (exec/fake.mjs render, design/stack-text.md). A stack string reads as its header with the V8 frame lines dropped, and the directories lean loaded the two copies from read as one token, so a unit that logs error.stack, returns it, or logs its own file location compares equal when the copies differ only by where lean put them and where the lines fall. logStack, returnsStack and engineStack (the engine's own TypeError, as in the immich pull requests) log or return a stack and move their lines in the candidate: PASS-bounded, a WITNESS before. logString logs String(e): PASS-bounded either way. logWhere logs import.meta.url and __filename: PASS-bounded, a WITNESS before. changedMessage and changedClass change the header of the logged stack: WITNESS. whereMessage keeps the location and changes the words after it: WITNESS. logNote logs a string that holds at-lines without a file position: it is the unit's own text, so a change in it is a WITNESS. engineMessage lets the engine's TypeError go uncaught and reads another property in the candidate: WITNESS on the thrown message, PASS-bounded before because an Error of the sandbox's realm rendered as an empty object. untouched is unchanged. The units use outside calls and untyped caught values, so lane A reads none of them and the pair checks lane B alone.
